content: शुल्कः, -ल्कम् [शुल्क्यते अतिसृज्यते कर्मणि घञ्] .²1 A toll, tax, customs, duty; particularly levied at ferries, passes, roads <ab>&c.</ab>; कः सुधीः संत्यजेद्भाण्डं शुल्कस्यैवातिसाध्वसात् <ls>H. 3. 125</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 159</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 47</ls>. .²2 Gain, profit. .²3 Money advanced to ratify a bargain. .²4 Purchase price (of a girl); money given to the parents of a bride; पीडितो दुहितृशुल्कसंस्थया <ls>R. 11. 38</ls>; न कन्यायाः पिता विद्वान् गृह्णीयाच्छुल्कमण्वपि <ls>Ms. 3. 51</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 204</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 93</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">98</ls>; <ls>Pratimā 1. 15</ls>. .²5 A nuptial present. .²6 Marriage settlement or dowry. .²7 Present given by the bride-groom to his bride. .²8 A dog; <ls>Uṇ. 3. 42</ls>. .²9 Price, value.
